topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I can’t believe it – turns out my online friend has been right here in the same city all along. We discovered this last night during a chat, and I was so surprised. We’ve known each other for a couple of years now, and I’ve always enjoyed our conversations. They’re always thoughtful and make me feel understood. I suggested we meet up for coffee this weekend to finally put faces to our usernames. It feels a bit like fate, you know? Two people who connect so well, only to find out they share the same streets. I’m really looking forward to it, hopeful that our friendship can grow even deeper in person.
